references.retention_details: Standalone storyboard guidance only; it informs the car's appearance and showroom setting, not a copied frame, pose, or target action.

subjects.description: A black sports car with a carbon fibre body.

sources.details: Storyboard reference depicts the car and its carbon fibre body; used for identity guidance.

description.text: sits low on an empty showroom floor, its carbon fibre body reduced to a faint silhouette. Only a thin sliver of reflected light traces the roofline and the curve of the front wing, while the surrounding space remains swallowed in shadow. The polished floor reads as a dark, quiet plane with barely visible reflections, and the negative space around the car makes the room feel vast and still. The car is motionless at first, held in the hush before movement, but the composition keeps its shape readable enough to register the low stance, the smooth bodywork, and the dense black finish. A faint sheen slides along the upper edge of the body, separating the car from the darkness without fully revealing it.
Near-total darkness holds the showroom; the car is a low, faint silhouette with a single reflected edge.
A low, enclosed showroom ambience carries a faint engine idle.
A thin reflected highlight creeps along the roofline and front wing as the silhouette becomes slightly more legible.

pulls forward across the showroom floor, rolling out of the shadow into a pool of light so its carbon fibre body catches a long specular highlight along the flank. The front of the car advances toward the camera as the darkness falls behind it, and the polished floor carries soft reflections beneath the tyres. The engine note rises gently with the movement, while the body shifts from a barely legible silhouette into a fully readable dark machine. The light picks out the curve of the hood, the line of the roof, and the smooth side panels, holding the car as the clear subject against the deep, empty showroom. The motion stays controlled and deliberate, a slow emergence rather than a burst of speed.
The car crosses from shadow into a pool of light; a long specular highlight runs along the carbon fibre flank.
The engine note rises gently and soft tyre roll moves across the polished floor.
The car continues forward, its front advancing toward the camera while the darkness recedes behind it.

soundscape: Low, enclosed showroom ambience with a faint engine idle that rises into a gentle engine note and soft tyre roll across a polished floor.
music: A restrained, low-string cinematic score with a slow pulse, mixed beneath the diegetic engine and tyre sounds.

summary.text: A black sports car emerges from darkness and pulls forward across a showroom floor, shifting from silhouette to a lit carbon fibre body.
